verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents a `permission` config that sets each action to run automatically, prompt, or be blocked. Rules can vary by tool input, `external_directory` governs paths outside the working directory, and custom agents can carry their own permission configuration. External tools are added explicitly via MCP, and the enterprise central config can restrict users to an internal AI gateway. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that permissions can allow or deny individual MCP servers or tools, evidence that an org-wide tool policy can be centrally enforced so users cannot override it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
